div.head: I Ew 1.1
div.ab: ⁊ gyf hwa butan porte ceapige, ðone sy he cyniges oferhyrnesse scyldig; ⁊ gange se team ðeah forð, oð man wite, hwær he oðstande.
⁊ gif hwa butan porte ceapige, ðonne sy he cyninges oferhyrnesse scyldig; ⁊ gange se team þeah forð, oð þæt man wite, hwær he oðstande.
Quodsi quis extra portum barganniet, ouerhyrnesse regis culpa sit; et procedat tamen aduocatio, donec sciatur, in quo consistet.

And if anyone buys outside a market town, he shall forfeit the sum due to subordinates to the king; but the production of warrantors shall nevertheless be continued, until the point is known at which they can no longer be found.
Und wenn einer ausserhalb der Stadt einkauft, dann sei er [die Summe für] Ungehorsam gegen den König schuldig; und es gehe der Gewährszug dennoch fort, bis (dass) man erkennt, wo er stehen bleibt.
And if anyone buys outside a town, then let him be liable [for the sum for] disobedience to the king; and let the vouching to warranty nevertheless go on until it is known where it comes to a stop.
